steps.title: 4 are to map the literature...
steps.instruction: 4 are to map the literature about dental emergencies in Brazil’s network of public health care services , describe the factors that modulate the use and access to such services and describe the gaps in literature. Inclusion Criteria The pre-established criterion of inclusion is to be an article about dental emergency care in the context of Brazilian National Health System. Exclusion Criteria The research question per se exclude s other countries than Brazil and private services, be them fee for service or paid by private insurance . In the analysis process of the studies, further exclusion criteria’s can be defined. Type of participants This study is focus ed in articles that provide dental emergen cy care in public services that are organized as part of the emergency care network in primary, secondary or tertiary points of care. Concept To understand how the use of services in the network occurs and factors that modulate the access to health services we will use the behavioral model of Andersen. The model bases itself on the fact that improved access to care is more properly addressed and explained through the relationship between predisposing, enabling, need, health behaviors and outcomes , considering contextual and individual factors and is presented in appendix 14. Research and study selection This scoping review will follow the five steps proposed by Ashley and O’Malley: (1) identifying the research question, (2) identifying relevant studies, (3) selecting studies, (4) collecting data, (5) mapping, summarizing and describing

steps.title: 5 the results 6
steps.instruction: 5 the results 6. In order to build the search strategy , an adapted version of the PECO question will be adopted (P: patient, E: exposure, C: comparison, O: outcomes), turning into PEC, in which “P ” means the population (users), “E” means exposure of interest (dental emergency), “C” means the context ( point of care within the health care network)7. The health descriptors and the combinations to build the strategies will be “emergencies”, “emergency”, “oral health”, “dentistry” and “health services” with Boolean operators such as “AND” and “OR”. The search will be carried out in the Medline (PubMed), Embase and Web of Science databases from their beginning until September of 2018. Also, the search was conducted in the gray literature using Google Scholar search engine. To identify articles potentially eligible for the study, titles and abstracts will be read and analyzed and t he selected studies will be fully read by two independent reviewers (KF, CMS), when relevant, data will be extract. If further information is needed, we will contact the authors of the included studies. Any disagreement will be solved by discussion. In case of no agreement , a third reviewer will be consulted (FNH). To organize the screening and data extraction a reference management software will be used. Extracting and charting results The data extraction will be performed in Excel files. The data extracted will be author, year of publication, journal, emergency concept, objectives, methodology (setting, design, population/sample, duration, outcome and exploratory variables) and results. The studies will be classified according to the point of emergency care network and according to the components of behavioral

Synthesis and reporting of results The general characteristics of included studies will be summarized. Descriptive statistical analysis will be performed. The data of the selected studies will be organize d as determinant factors and gaps in use of dental emergency services following Andersen model. A paper summarizing the findings from this review will be published in a peer-reviewed journal. Prisma extension for scoping review will be used to report this review9. Funding None. Authors’ contributions All authors contributed to conceptualizing and designing the study. KF will drafted the protocol and CMS and FNH will made major revisions. All authors will read and approved the final version of the protocol. The same process will be used to write the final manuscript. Competing interests None. Ethics approval Not required. Discussion The results will be discussed in the context of the current literature, practice and policy. Conclusion and implications for research and practice

steps.title: 7 This research intends to give...
steps.instruction: 7 This research intends to give a wide picture of dental emergency network care and explore the research gaps. It is expected that the results of this review can help managers, professionals and researchers in the area of health services and systems, specifi cally in what pertains to the dental emergency network of care.

description: 2 Abstract Introduction: considering the high prevalence of dental caries, understand the factors that may influence the use of network health services in dental emergency cases is important to improve the access and qualify the emergency net care (ENC). To provide an overview about this field in Brazil we consider performing a scoping review. The aim of this publication is to present the protocol of a scoping review about dental emergency in public health services in Brazil. Methods and analysis: the review will follow the Joanna Briggs Institute scoping review methods protocol. We will search for relevant studies in MEDLINE, EMBASE, SCIELO and perform a gray literature search using Google Scholar. Two independent reviewers will select the articles. Discrepancies will be solved through discussion and, in case of disagreement, with a third reviewer . Descriptive statistical analysis will be performed. Ethics and dissemination : A paper summarizing the findings from this review will be published in a peer -reviewed journal. Ethical approval is not required. Strengths and limitations of the study Results from this scoping review will contribute to a broader perspective of the factors and gaps that influence the use of network health services in dental emergency care in Brazil. A potential limitation could be the small number of eligible articles in the literature. As this is a scoping review, the quality of the evidence will not be assessed. Keywords: emergencies, oral health, health services, health care 3 Introduction Dental emergency is associate d with high prevalence of dental caries , disparities and access to dental care 1. Health care in Brazilian health system is organized as a network1,2. Understand the use of the different points of the net for dental emergencies care is important to improve the access and qualify the dental emergency network care3.
